questions.question: Why do these two logs disagree?
options: === coerces and == does not, so the second log is the sloppy one.
== coerces, so 0 matches false. === does not coerce, so the types stay different.

questions.explanation: == converts before comparing. === compares type and value. Prefer === unless you have a specific reason to coerce.
